title: About SPARK
html:
SPARK is an AI product studio led by Amichai Oron, a fractional AI product architect who has spent a decade embedded with startup leadership teams — owning strategy, roadmaps, discovery, PRDs and AI flows.

The focus is narrow. Agentic AI: multi-agent systems, connectors, agent and data flows, human-in-the-loop review. Medical and clinical AI: revenue-cycle automation, trial search, hospital IoT, medical devices. Cyber: products where AI output has to be governed and trusted.

45+ products built end to end. Clients have raised, merged and exited for $839M+ — SoniVie ($600M, Boston Scientific), MarketMan ($100M), Nym ($94M), Suridata ($45M).
